(1) Strong Balance Sheet with Ample Liquidity Total liquidity was $539.7 million as of September 30, 2026, including approximately $505.0 million of available borrowing capacity under our revolving credit facility and total cash and cash equivalents of $34.7 million. In August 2026, WBI Operating LLC ("OpCo") issued an additional $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.50% fixed-rate senior unsecured notes due 2033 under the existing indenture (the “Additional Notes”). The Additional Notes have terms identical to those of the existing $600.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.50% fixed-rate senior unsecured notes due 2033 that were issued in October 2025 (the "Notes"), other than the issue date. The Additional Notes and the Notes are treated as a single series for all purposes under the existing indenture, bringing the total aggregate principal amount to $750.0 million. The Company had $1.837 billion of total borrowings outstanding as of September 30, 2026, as compared to $1.636 billion as of June 30, 2026. 3 Third Quarter 2026 Dividend The Board declared a dividend on our Class A shares of $0.05 per share, payable on December 10, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 25, 2026, and a corresponding required cash distribution to OpCo unitholders. Updated 2026 Outlook WaterBridge is updating its full-year 2026 guidance across three key metrics. Due to produced water handling volumes exceeding expectations across the Company's Delaware Basin footprint, produced water handling volumes are now expected in the range of 2.65 to 2.75 million Bbl/d and Adjusted EBITDA guidance is now expected in the range of $465 to $485 million, which represent increases of 2% and 4% at the midpoint of the ranges, respectively. Due to timing expectations of capital outlay for projects shifting from 2026 into 2027, capital expenditures guidance has narrowed to a range of $530 to $560 million, a decrease of 3% at the midpoint of the range.
